card.name: Linking words before PD-1 drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or units (that, receiving, with, and, or, /mL, mg) right before an immunotherapy drug name such as BAVENCIO, nivolumab, pembrolizumab or relatlimab in oncology labels.

modes.label: Patients receiving the drug
modes.description: The word receiving after a patient count, just before the drug name.
modes.example: Thyroiditis occurred in 0.2% (4/1854) of patients<< receiving>> BAVENCIO, including Grade

modes.label: Combination dosing links
modes.description: With, and, or, or a unit between two drugs in a combination regimen.
modes.example: With the combination of cabozantinib<< and>> nivolumab, Grades 3

modes.label: Unit before second drug
modes.description: A dose unit such as mg or /mL right before the next drug name.

card.writes: Output effect is unclear; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
card.plain: It marks the small word just before an immunotherapy drug name is mentioned in cancer drug labels.
